import copy,json,work

def chk(req,ev,pol,want):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=work.evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==want,(got,want)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==before
    assert set(got)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}
chk(base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
chk(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'x':[1,2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':[1,2]},'conditions':{'b':2,'a':1},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'supported','value':{'x':[1,2]},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
chk(base,[{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':True,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
chk(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
chk(base,[{'source':'x','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['x'],'unknowns':[]})
r=json.load(open('requests.json')); e=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); assert [work.evaluate(x,e,pol) for x in r]==json.load(open('report.json'))
print('comprehensive checks passed')
